name: blueprint/design-token-lint
description: Token spec validation as a gate step: run the validator, receipt the verdict, red blocks the design change, the fix loop reruns only it
recipe: run the validator over the token spec -> receipt the verdict (exit + tail) -> red blocks the change - the fix loop reruns only the validator -> green: the gate passes
pitfalls: the validator is a local script - its exit code is the verdict
warnings that exit 0 are green, whatever they say
a red receipt is why the design change did not ship
